subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw permanently define `!` as agent-visible persisted local-shell output and `!!` as persisted history-only output behind session-scoped consent?
rationale: This introduces a user-facing shell convention, a sensitive-output consent policy, and a hidden admin transcript mutation API; code-level repairs cannot determine whether those permanent semantics belong in the product.

options.title: Approve session-scoped sharing
options.body: Keep the convention only after the originating-session, consent-lifecycle, replay, and proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Keep shell output local
options.body: Decline the persistence API and retain the current local-only shell behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve session-scoped sharing
recommendation.body: Keep the convention only after the originating-session, consent-lifecycle, replay, and proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest combined ownership signal across TUI product behavior, session lifecycle, and gateway chat handling.
